result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would ensure that every person has access to the basic necessities of life—food, clean water, shelter, healthcare, and education—without exception. This foundational change would address the root causes of so much suffering, inequality, and conflict, empowering people to thrive and contribute to a more just and sustainable world.

By eliminating poverty and insecurity, we could unlock human potential on a global scale, fostering creativity, collaboration, and compassion. It’s a change that would ripple outward, transforming societies, economies, and even our relationship with the planet. While it’s a monumental goal, it’s also one that aligns with the collective efforts of countless people and organizations already working toward these ideals. What would you prioritize if you had the chance to change the world?
